title: Topology-aware Multi-Site health trend calculations

opportunity.rootCause: Health history retained rows for removed upstreams, while trend, acknowledgement, and summary calculations used the complete history with the current upstream count.
opportunity.risk: A topology change could leave a Site degraded or critical because of failures belonging to an upstream that is no longer configured. Recent observations for current upstreams could also be hidden by retired rows within a small query window.

implementation.behavior: Trend-facing calculations filter observations to current upstream IDs while the raw history endpoint remains audit-complete. Direct trend and summary read the bounded retention maximum before filtering, then apply the requested display window.

red.result: failed 1/1 before implementation because FilterToCurrentUpstreams did not exist

green.focused: passed 19/19 across health trend, topology filter, endpoint, and summary contracts

verification.relatedRegression: passed 83/83 across empty-snapshot, bootstrap-failure, configuration, persistence, activation, security, health-trend, UI-contract, and handoff classes

boundary: Live PostgreSQL topology-change execution was not available because 127.0.0.1:5432 was not listening
